notes: The 1995 volume of the Recreation and Park Commission, the last in the run. Curated: contracts, demolitions, acquisitions and design approvals.

coverage.remaining: Routine items not curated. Not placed: the recreation building at the new Chinatown Park on the Cathay Mortuary site (CICI/R&W, $445,792; no address), demolition of the Richmond-Sunset sewer treatment plant at the west end of Golden Gate Park (Evans Brothers, $1,818,000; no page), the 10th and Fulton playground in Golden Gate Park, the Civic Center Plaza playground, Portola Recreation Center, Seward Street Mini Park garden, Candlestick seating.
coverage.note: Resolution numbers from 1995 run year-month-serial (9504-73). Dated by the running head. Curated list F1995.py.
